title: Beaufort Learning Harbor v10.37
notes: Adds an adult-only Lesson Pack Editor with ordered lesson sections, separate practice and lab prompts, media-needs checks, no-equipment paths, before/after preview, deterministic fail-closed draft-package import/export, and non-destructive legacy Curriculum Studio migration. Parent navigation maps the editor to Support while Teacher, Director, and Admin use their build/operations groups. No live curriculum apply occurs in this release.
